item.title: TelcoChisel OS 2026.2 Released: Tactical Cyberpunk XFCE Desktop, Zero-Drop Compositor & Live Hardware Telemetry HUD
item.dc:creator: TelcoChisel Core Security Engineering
item.description: TelcoChisel OS 2026.2 has been released, featuring a ground-up tactical cyberpunk XFCE 4.18 desktop environment with 450+ lines of custom GTK3 CSS, zero-drop Picom GLX compositor optimized for high-framerate SDR waterfalls, live Genmon panel telemetry widgets (SDR prober, 5G Core daemon monitor, VPN tunnel state), forensic Thunar UCA actions, and the Tactical Conky HUD (Super+H).
item.content:encoded:
TelcoChisel OS 2026.2 delivers a comprehensive upgrade to the graphical desktop experience, specifically engineered for radio frequency auditors, telecommunications penetration testers, and signals intelligence operators.

Key Highlights of TelcoChisel OS 2026.2:

  • Tactical Cyberpunk GTK3 Theme: Deep obsidian canvas (#0a0e17) accented with neon cyan (#00ffd5), electric amber (#e8921e), and alert coral (#ff4466).
  • Zero-Drop GLX Compositor (Picom): Tailored with use-damage = false and explicit window exclusions for Gqrx, Inspectrum, URH, and Wireshark to guarantee zero tearing and zero dropped frames during wideband SDR I/Q waterfall sweeps.
  • Live Taskbar Telemetry (Genmon): Real-time panel indicators for attached USB SDR transceivers (USRP, HackRF, BladeRF, LimeSDR, PlutoSDR), Open5GS 5G Core daemon health, and WireGuard/OpenVPN tunnel interfaces.
  • Tactical Conky HUD: Heads-up display activated via Super + H providing instant visibility into RF hardware, 5G Core subscriber state, and CPU real-time performance.
  • Forensic Thunar File Manager: Pinned capture trees and 8 context actions for GSMTAP dissection, I/Q analysis, pySim-shell SIM interaction, and SHA-256 evidence hashing.

item.title: TelcoChisel OS 2026.1 Released: The Ultimate Linux Distribution for Telecom Red Teams, 5G SA Core & SDR Security
item.dc:creator: TelcoChisel Core Security Engineering
item.description: TelcoChisel OS 2026.1 has been officially released. Built upon Ubuntu 24.04 LTS with an ultra-low-latency 1000Hz Linux kernel, TelcoChisel OS integrates 100 specialized telecom security tools across 11 domains, dual desktop sessions (XFCE 4.18 and i3 RFS Style), and full out-of-the-box driver support for USRP, HackRF, BladeRF, LimeSDR, and SIMtrace2 hardware.
item.content:encoded:
TelcoChisel OS 2026.1 ("Noble Cellular") has been officially launched as the world's most advanced open-source Linux operating system engineered exclusively for cellular security auditing, 5G Standalone penetration testing, and RF protocol analysis.

Key Highlights of TelcoChisel OS 2026.1:

  • 100 Pre-compiled Telecom Security Tools: Comprehensive coverage across Radio Frequency & DSP, GSM/2G/3G auditing, 4G/5G Core/RAN testbeds, SIM/Smart Card extraction, Signaling (SS7, Diameter, GTP, SBI), Protocol Dissection, and O-RAN security.
  • Real-Time 1000Hz Low-Latency Kernel: Tuned for zero-drop packet processing at 10GbE rates and sub-millisecond 5G NR TTI timing budgets.
  • Dual Desktop Environments: Highly-polished XFCE 4.18 workstation desktop alongside a dedicated 10-workspace i3 Tiling Window Manager (RFS Style) optimized for field operations.
  • Full Hardware Integration: Automated udev rules, FPGA image downloaders, and out-of-the-box support for Ettus USRP, BladeRF, HackRF One, LimeSDR, RTL-SDR, SIMtrace2, and PCSC smart card readers.
  • High-Speed Global Mirroring: Available now on SourceForge with SHA-256 integrity verification.

For more information, visit https://telcochisel.com or download the ISO image from SourceForge.

item.title: TelcoChisel OS Introduces i3 RFS Style: 10 Dedicated Workspaces for Cellular Red Team Field Operations
item.dc:creator: TelcoChisel Desktop Team
item.description: The new i3 RFS Style session in TelcoChisel OS provides field operators with 10 dedicated telecom workspaces, direct diagnostic hotkeys (Mod4+F1..F4), and a real-time status bar reporting live network, VPN, load, and UTC telemetry.
